E0923

`impl Point.Hash` names no trait

What

`impl Point.Hash` names no trait

Why

An `impl Type.Trait` block implements a trait the program declares or imports, or one the compiler owns; no trait named `Hash` is in scope here.

Fix

Declare or import `Hash: trait`, correct the trait name, or write `impl Point {` for methods of `Point` alone.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0923: tests/ui/impl_unknown_trait.stderr.

 Why: An `impl Type.Trait` block implements a trait the program declares or imports, or one the compiler owns; no trait named `Hash` is in scope here
 Fix: Declare or import `Hash: trait`, correct the trait name, or write `impl Point {` for methods of `Point` alone
